253: 2. (1) There is also room inside the oven to place a pot and the pot may remain there if the food will shrivel and the shriveling will be detrimental to the food. Rather, because he wants to convey the prohibition in the case of shrinkage, and it is beneficial for him even if it is only inferred from his words.
3. (2) These fuels make coal and there is a concern that he will stoke the coals.

4. (3) That is olive press residue. And some say the same applies to sesame press residue, as they are also included in the category of ash mentioned in the Mishnah, as will be explained later in Chapter 247, Section 3, regarding insulation.
5. (4) Or with wood - similarly, charcoal and large animal bones
